name: nexora-fullstack-ts
description: NEXORA Marketing & Network Management Platform - Full Stack TypeScript

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=client && npm install --workspace=server && npm install --workspace=shared
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@nexora/shared && npm run build --workspace=@nexora/client && npm run build --workspace=@nexora/server
scripts.build:force: npx --yes typescript -p shared/tsconfig.json && npx --yes typescript -p server/tsconfig.json && npm run build --workspace=@nexora/client
